history.overview: The Trial of Endurance tests combatants’ ability to withstand prolonged combat, exhaustion, and Discord‑charged fatigue.

timeline.name: Endurance Arena Design
timeline.description: Muramite engineers created a trial focused on stamina and attrition.

timeline.name: Attrition Mechanisms
timeline.description: Long corridors and pits were added to force extended engagements.

timeline.name: Dragorn Endurance Trials
timeline.description: Dragorn captives were forced into prolonged combat cycles.

timeline.name: Discord Fatigue Integration
timeline.description: Discord pylons were installed to drain stamina and intensify exhaustion.
